description: This file defines the A11yController class responsible for managing accessibility focus, regions, sections, and user interaction states within the Mattermost web application. It handles keyboard and mouse events to facilitate accessible navigation and focus management.

classes.name: A11yController
classes.description: Main class managing accessibility focus, regions, sections, and user interaction states for the web app.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes event listeners and clears active regions and focus states.

methods.name: storeOriginElement
methods.description: Stores a DOM element as the origin element for focus restoration.

methods.name: resetOriginElement
methods.description: Resets the stored origin element to null.

methods.name: nextRegion
methods.description: Moves focus to the next accessible region.

methods.name: previousRegion
methods.description: Moves focus to the previous accessible region.

methods.name: nextSection
methods.description: Moves focus to the next section within the current region.

methods.name: previousSection
methods.description: Moves focus to the previous section within the current region.

methods.name: nextElement
methods.description: Sets focus to a specific element and its parent region/section if applicable.

methods.name: restoreOriginFocus
methods.description: Restores focus to the stored origin element.

methods.name: cancelNavigation
methods.description: Resets active regions, sections, focus, and interaction states.

methods.name: setActiveRegion
methods.description: Sets a DOM element as the active region and updates focus and visual state.

methods.name: setActiveSection
methods.description: Sets a DOM element as the active section and updates focus and visual state.

methods.name: setActiveElement
methods.description: Sets a DOM element as the active element and updates focus and visual state.

methods.name: setCurrentFocus
methods.description: Focuses the currently active element and updates visual focus state.

methods.name: updateActiveRegion
methods.description: Adds visual focus to the active region and makes it focusable.

methods.name: updateActiveSection
methods.description: Adds visual focus to the active section and makes it focusable.

methods.name: updateActiveElement
methods.description: Adds visual focus to the active element.

methods.name: udpateCurrentFocus
methods.description: Adds visual focus class to the focused element.

methods.name: clearActiveRegion
methods.description: Removes focus and visual state from the active region.

methods.name: clearActiveSection
methods.description: Removes focus and visual state from the active section.

methods.name: clearActiveElement
methods.description: Removes focus and visual state from the active element.

methods.name: clearCurrentFocus
methods.description: Removes visual focus from all elements and optionally blurs the active element.

methods.name: resetInterractionStates
methods.description: Resets all user interaction state flags.

methods.name: getAllRegions
methods.description: Returns all DOM elements with the class for regions.

methods.name: getAllSectionsForRegion
methods.description: Returns all sections within a given region.

methods.name: sortElementsByAttributeOrder
methods.description: Sorts DOM elements based on a custom sort order attribute.

methods.name: elementIsVisible
methods.description: Checks if a DOM element is visible.

methods.name: getAllModals
methods.description: Returns all modal DOM elements.

methods.name: getAllPopups
methods.description: Returns all popup DOM elements.

methods.name: getLoopNavigationAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the loop navigation attribute value from an element.

methods.name: getOrderReverseAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the order reverse attribute value from an element.

methods.name: getFocusChildAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the focus child attribute value from an element.

methods.name: isElementValid
methods.description: Checks if a DOM element is valid for focus and navigation.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events for accessibility navigation.

methods.name: handleKeyUp
methods.description: Resets interaction flags on key release.

methods.name: handleMouseClick
methods.description: Handles mouse click events to reset navigation.

methods.name: handleMouseDown
methods.description: Handles mouse down events.

methods.name: handleMouseUp
methods.description: Handles mouse up events.

methods.name: handleFocus
methods.description: Handles focus events to manage focus navigation.

methods.name: handleA11yFocus
methods.description: Handles custom focus events for accessibility.

methods.name: handleWindowBlur
methods.description: Handles window blur events to update focus state.

methods.name: handleActiveRegionUpdate
methods.description: Updates active region on custom event.

methods.name: handleActiveSectionUpdate
methods.description: Updates active section on custom event.

methods.name: handleActiveElementUpdate
methods.description: Updates active element on custom event.
